Usage: ai-bdd compile [options] [docs...]

extract features and scenarios from stale docs into reviewable plans

Arguments:
  docs        doc paths or globs (default: all configured docs)

Options:
  --full      re-extract every section, ignoring staleness
  --dry-run   extract but write nothing
  --check     write nothing; exit 4 if any plan is stale
  -h, --help  display help for command
